sealed_record.thesis: The optical supply chain feeding NVDA's AI infrastructure buildout is booked through end of calendar 2027 per multiple CEO transcripts: Coherent ('fiscal 2027 completely booked out'), AOI + Coherent combined 'still very tough to meet customer demand next 3 years,' Elazr GM ('entire optical supply chain facing major shortages'). CPO/1.6T and NPO scale-out has not yet hit inflection — NVDA benefits as the bottleneck shifts from packaging/test (resolved) to InP laser production (unresolved, years-long). Market consensus treats NVDA's upside as already priced; the CPO inflection and 1.6T transition are a second wave not yet in estimates.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -30.6%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind: skandal dan pencopotan Jensen Huang (8 Nov), aturan sementara ekspor chip AI dari Departemen Perdagangan AS (16 Nov). Long AI/semikonduktor 0 dari 12 untung.
